snippet.title: Operation7: Showdown - Launch Trailer | PS4
snippet.description:
Gear up for an operation filled with destruction, strategy, and teamwork and lead your squad to victory!

Welcome to Operation7: Showdown, where its battlefield thirsts for seasoned veterans and brave soldiers to take charge. The battle begins in North America on October 23 and expands to Europe, Japan, and Asia in the coming months – available on PS4 and compatible with PS5 devices.

Operation7: Showdown is a free-to-play multiplayer third-person shooter and a sequel to the beloved PC version of Operation7. It’s time for you to join forces with your squad and showcase your skill on the battlefield!

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/op7showdown
Twitter: https://twitter.com/op7showdown
Discord: https://discord.gg/pz3fEXY

Rated Mature: Blood, Intense Violence, Language
